dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: These items are really hard to find...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Well, you must know that the Jade Chamber has finally been rebuilt, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: I never thought that such a huge place could be rebuilt just like that...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Baiwen came looking for me several days ago, asking me to prepare a few items to help redecorate the Jade Chamber's interior.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Look, she even passed me a checklist and all, telling me to keep the various items recorded there in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: I'll be honest with you, though. My work at the Ministry of Civil Affairs has been getting more hectic by the day. There's just no time to help her...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Could you help me make the trip to find these items, Traveler? Baiwen did look like she was rather anxious for this to get done.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Let me see... Hmm, they first want a book called "Meadow of Gems," and some small bamboo ornaments.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: You can ask Jifang about the book. As for the bamboo ornaments, I believe that Master Lu of Fanmu Carpenter's makes them.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: I'll leave it in your hands, then. Ah, the rebuilt Jade Chamber truly is a magnificent sight...
